title: eranthemum album
intro: Eranthemum album, commonly known as White Lily or Gloriosa, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which make it a potential treatment for various health conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Eranthemum album include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and antioxidant effects.
